name: create_datatable
purpose: Create a new UDataTable asset with a chosen RowStruct — rows can be written today but no table can be created.
cooked: works — creates a new loose asset; RowStruct may be cooked /Game or /Script
hazards: UDataTableFactory::ConfigureProperties is MODAL (DataTableFactory.cpp:176) — never call it
CanCreateAsset raises modal dialogs for invalid names and overwrite (AssetTools.cpp:4294/4301/4331)
Pre-validate name/package/map-collision/existence before CreateAsset
Pass a matching AssetClass or CreateAsset's ensure-dialogs fire (AssetTools.cpp:1634,1640)

name: delete_datatable_row
purpose: Remove ONE row; today the only deletion path is whole-table replace (read-all/rewrite-all).
cooked: degraded — .pak tables mutate in memory only, report savable:false
hazards: RemoveRow opens its own FScopedTransaction (DataTableEditorUtils.cpp:463) — nests harmlessly
Confirm gate required (destructive, match write_datatable_rows)

name: rename_datatable_row
purpose: Rename a row key in place preserving data + order (currently impossible without full replace).
cooked: degraded — .pak tables mutate in memory only, report savable:false
hazards: RenameRow silently collides if new name exists — pre-check GetRowMap().Contains

name: duplicate_datatable_row
purpose: Clone a row under a new key — the natural make-a-variant-item/recipe primitive for a data-driven game.
cooked: degraded — .pak tables mutate in memory only, report savable:false

name: move_datatable_row
purpose: Reorder rows (row order matters for iteration order and designer diffing; unreachable today).
cooked: degraded — .pak tables mutate in memory only, report savable:false
hazards: ERowMoveDirection is nested inside FDataTableEditorUtils (h:65-69) — unqualified use is a compile error

name: export_datatable_csv
purpose: Round-trip tables through the CSV format designers/Excel use — read_datatable only emits JSON.
cooked: works — cooked tables retain row data; export reflects in-memory rows
hazards: writeTo outside the project dir must be refused (path traversal guard)

name: import_datatable_csv
purpose: Bulk-fill a table from CSV text (designer-facing interchange); complements JSON-only write paths.
cooked: degraded — mutates in memory; unsavable for .pak tables, report savable:false
hazards: CreateTableFromCSVString REPLACES the whole table (empties first) — confirm gate required
Claim replaced:true only when the problems array is empty

name: set_composite_datatable_parents
purpose: Author UCompositeDataTable parent stacks (DLC/patch row overlays) — the only meaningful composite mutation.
cooked: degraded — append to cooked composite works in memory; unsavable
hazards: Replace mode must go through FProperty + PostEditChangeProperty so OnParentTablesUpdated fires
Pre-check parent != self; engine FindLoops is protected/unexported

name: create_curve
purpose: Create UCurveFloat/UCurveVector/UCurveLinearColor assets — no endpoint can make a standalone curve asset.
engineApi: UCurveFactory via IAssetTools::CreateAsset vtable dispatch (CurveFactory.h:16-29; EditorFactories.cpp:7261-7270)
cooked: works — creates loose assets, unaffected
hazards: Base UCurveFactory::ConfigureProperties opens modal SClassPickerDialog (EditorFactories.cpp:7231-7259) — never call
Use typed subclass factories whose ConfigureProperties are non-modal return true
FactoryCreateNew unexported on MinimalAPI class — only callable via CreateAsset virtual dispatch
Package-exists pre-check required (CanCreateAsset modal overwrite prompt)

name: set_curve_keys
purpose: Structured key editing on any FRichCurve-bearing asset — closes the element-level-addressing gap for curves.
cooked: degraded — edits work in memory; unsavable for .pak assets, report savable:false
hazards: AddRichCurve hard-check()s on SimpleCurves-mode curve tables (CurveTable.cpp:554-557) — EDITOR CRASH
Gate curve-table rows on GetCurveTableMode() and refuse simple-mode tables with a typed error
Raw struct-array property writes skip tangent auto-computation — use the FRichCurve ops

name: read_curve
purpose: Read keys AND numerically evaluate a curve at N sample points — the verification half of set_curve_keys.
cooked: works — fully functional on .pak curves (pure read)

name: create_curve_table
purpose: Create a UCurveTable asset and optionally bulk-fill from CSV — curve tables are currently untouchable.
cooked: works — creates loose assets, unaffected
hazards: MakeNewCurveTable pre-seeds a stray 'Curve' row in SimpleCurves mode (CurveTableFactory.cpp:63-77)
Subsequent AddRichCurve trips check() (CurveTable.cpp:556) — EDITOR CRASH; call EmptyTable() first
UCurveTableFactory::ConfigureProperties is MODAL (CurveTableFactory.cpp:55) — never call
Echo curveTableMode in the response so agents know which row ops are legal

name: create_string_table
purpose: Create a UStringTable asset — first step of a localization-ready text pipeline.
cooked: works — creates loose assets
hazards: Package-exists pre-check required (CanCreateAsset modal overwrite prompt)

name: set_string_table_entry
purpose: Add/update/remove source strings in a string table — makes agent-authored UI text localizable.
cooked: degraded — in-memory edit works; unsavable for .pak tables, report savable:false
hazards: Entries live in private non-UPROPERTY FStringTablePtr — undo does NOT restore; report undoable:false

name: list_string_table_entries
purpose: Dump all key/source-string pairs (+namespace) of a string table — works on cooked base-game text too.
cooked: works — string table entries survive cooking

name: get_config_value
purpose: Structured read of any .ini value or whole section (merged runtime view or specific Default*.ini file).
cooked: n/a — config is not asset content, unaffected
hazards: File allowlist only — arbitrary file paths refused

name: set_config_value
purpose: Write a config value to a Default*.ini with explicit flush — make-this-setting-stick, currently hand-edit only.
cooked: n/a — config is not asset content, unaffected
hazards: Write does not hot-apply to constructed objects — response must carry appliedLive:false
Confirm-gated; echo previous value for rollback (undo cannot restore an ini)
Default*.ini allowlist only — never merged G*Ini caches or arbitrary paths

name: get_settings_config_source
purpose: For any UDeveloperSettings class, report which ini file + section its values live in.
cooked: n/a — CDO-based, unaffected

name: list_cultures
purpose: Enumerate cultures known to the engine's ICU data — read-only grounding for localization work.
cooked: n/a — unaffected

name: list_savegames
purpose: Enumerate save-game files (name, size, timestamp) under the project's Saved/SaveGames dir.
cooked: n/a — filesystem, not assets; project save dir only
hazards: dir param must not escape Saved/SaveGames (.. / absolute paths refused)
ISaveGameSystem::GetSaveGameNames default returns false — file scan is the authoritative source

name: read_savegame
purpose: Load a standard UE .sav slot and dump the USaveGame object's properties via the reflection serializer.
cooked: n/a — reads files, not assets; needs the save's USaveGame subclass loaded in-editor
hazards: Synchronous load mid-frame — refuse saves over 64 MB with a clear error
Transient USaveGame must be GC-guarded (FGCObjectScopeGuard) while serializing
RamaSave-format files return null — error must point at read_rama_savefile

name: list_primary_assets
purpose: Read-only dump of UAssetManager primary asset types and ids — shows how DDS2 organizes scannable content.
cooked: works — primary asset info includes .pak-mounted content
hazards: Gate on UAssetManager::IsInitialized() — error with retry hint when not ready
ScanPathsForPrimaryAssets deliberately NOT exposed

name: set_struct_member
purpose: Retype/re-default/rename an EXISTING UserDefinedStruct member in place — remove+re-add breaks graph pins today.
cooked: refuses — editor-only struct description data stripped from .pak structs
hazards: Change* triggers struct recompile + dependent-BP reinstancing — must not run inside an outer transaction
Rename collision — pre-check with IsUniqueVariableFriendlyName

name: move_struct_member
purpose: Reorder UserDefinedStruct members (pairs with set_struct_member to close in-place struct editing).
cooked: refuses — as set_struct_member
hazards: Same recompile/reinstancing cascade as set_struct_member
EMovePosition nested in FStructureEditorUtils (:108-112) — qualify at call sites

name: read_rama_savefile
purpose: Read the static-data header of a DDS2 gameplay save (RamaSaveSystem format) — the format the game actually uses.
cooked: n/a — file-based; concrete URamaSaveObject subclass may live in the game pak
hazards: Shipped plugin source is STUB bodies; real logic only in prebuilt DLL, no import .lib — reflection-only
Reflection call silently no-ops (FileIOSuccess=false) if a stub-rebuilt DLL is loaded — live probe required
Do NOT add RamaSaveSystem to Build.cs; GC-guard the transient URamaSaveObject during dump
RamaSave_LoadFromFile (world-mutating loader) deliberately NOT exposed
